help.sampleReport.title: Sample import report
help.sampleReport.description: This example shows the report QFlowLearn creates after analyzing a QTI 1.2 package. It separates imported questions from questions that need review, keeps source XML available, and explains each warning.
help.fidelity.title: Import compatibility
help.fidelity.subtitle: See what QFlowLearn imports automatically, what it converts, and what you need to review before creating an assessment.
help.fidelity.preservesDetail: For supported question types, QFlowLearn preserves learner-facing content, answer keys, scoring, question order, media references, and available accessibility information. Ambiguous or unsupported behavior is flagged and its source XML is kept for comparison.
help.fidelity.useReportDetail: Review the import in this order.
help.fidelity.importsExports: Imports and exports supported question types
help.fidelity.qti12: QFlowLearn preserves supported content and scoring, and flags vendor-specific behavior for review.
help.fidelity.qti2: QFlowLearn preserves supported content and keeps unsupported source XML with the review report.
help.fidelity.qti3: QFlowLearn preserves QTI 3 behavior that maps to its supported question types.
help.portability.title: Your content stays portable
help.portability.subtitle: QFlowLearn stores each canonical assessment as QTI 3 and reports known conversion changes for the destination you choose.
help.portability.chargesDetail: Basic portability does not include a free institutional production tier. QFlowLearn charges for hosted production services, institutional controls, and support.
help.portability.termsDetail: The hosted terms cover content ownership, AI processing, account closure, and how signed agreements apply.
help.fidelity.stepImportDetail: Choose one or more files. QFlowLearn detects the format for you.
help.fidelity.stepSummaryDetail: See what imported, what needs review, and whether the import is ready.
help.fidelity.stepReviewDetail: Warnings keep source XML, previews, notes, and review state together.
help.fidelity.stepCreateDetail: Approve the ready import to create assessment records.
help.fidelity.importedDetail: Learner content, answer keys, scoring, order, and supported media were imported.
help.fidelity.convertedDetail: The source structure was converted to the authoring model while behavior stays the same.
help.fidelity.needsReviewDetail: A warning identifies ambiguous, proprietary, or partially supported behavior.
help.fidelity.sourcePreservedDetail: Original XML remains available with an editable placeholder.
help.fidelity.warningTaskDetail: A warning points to behavior that needs a person to check.
help.fidelity.sourceAvailableDetail: Source XML remains attached for comparison or rebuilding.
help.fidelity.reportConversionsDetail: The report separates automatic conversions from questions needing review.
help.portability.commitmentOwnershipDeta: You own your source files, questions, assessments, metadata, and exported packages. QFlowLearn uses private content only to provide the service you request.
help.portability.commitmentFee: Basic portability has no export fee
help.portability.commitmentFeeDetail: Basic individual import and standards-based export have no separate portability charge. File-size, compute, rate, and abuse limits may apply.
help.portability.commitmentAi: AI processes content only when you request it
help.portability.commitmentAiDetail: When you start AI-assisted generation, QFlowLearn sends source material and generation settings to the AI provider configured for your workspace. Recovery, review, and export do not send content to an AI model.
help.portability.commitmentLossDetail: Import reports and destination preflight mark content as preserved, transformed, warning, or blocked. Export receipts record the destination and evidence available at export.
help.portability.commitmentQti: QTI 3 remains available when hosted access ends
help.portability.commitmentQtiDetail: Before account closure, download each canonical assessment as a QTI 3 package. You can also access original sources and review reports while the workspace remains open.
help.portability.paidAi: Additional AI capacity and private model configuration
help.portability.paidBulk: Bulk conversion, migration assistance, and automation
help.portability.paidReview: Collaborative review, shared-bank governance, and institutional controls
help.portability.paidIntegrations: Direct integrations, managed support, and QFlowLearn Delivery
help.fidelity.reportDetail: Every import records its format, question status, warnings, review notes, source XML, and QFlowLearn preview for testing or approval.
